scenario: Customer reads a card number aloud; speech-to-text transcribed the digits as words.
notes: The realistic transcription case. A speech pipeline that has not applied inverse text normalisation emits number words, not digits. If the detector only matches digit patterns, this is a silent PCI leak.

conversation.text: I can take that payment over the phone. Whenever you're ready, go ahead with the card number.
Okay, it's four one one one, one one one one, one one one one, one one one one.
Thank you, and the three digit security code on the back?
It's one two three, and it expires April twenty twenty eight.
Perfect, that's approved. Anything else I can help you with today?

expected.text: four one one one, one one one one, one one one one, one one one one
